{{short description|A made-up structure for the tests}}
A '''widget''' is a set <math>W</math> with a map {{mvar|f}}.<ref name="a">{{cite book |last=Doe |title=Widgets |year=2001}}</ref>{{anchor|widgets}}

== Definition ==
A widget is a pair {{math|(''W'', ''f'')}}.{{cn}}

'''Theorem 1.''' Each widget has a fixed point.<ref name="a"/>
: The fixed point is unique.

'''Proof.''' Take the least element.

=== Statement ===
{{math theorem|Widget lemma|Each map {{mvar|f}} is injective.}}

==== Proof ====
It follows from the definition.{{sfn|Doe|2001|p=3}}

== Equations ==
{{NumBlk|:|<math>f(x) = x</math>|{{EquationRef|1}}}}

A long argument.
